children: Turkey appointed Yusuf Kenan Bagir as chairman of the banking watchdog BDDK, a presidential decision published in the Official Gazette showed on Friday.
He replaces Sahap Kavcioglu, who submitted his resignation on November 11 after allegations, which he denied, of links to the country's investment fund crisis.
